card.line: Anathoth was a priests' city in the land of Benjamin, a few miles from Jerusalem, and it was the hometown of the prophet Jeremiah.

moments.title: A city given to the priests
moments.text: Anathoth was one of four cities in Benjamin's land that were given to the family of Aaron the priest, along with the grassy land around it for their animals.

moments.title: Abiathar's fields in Anathoth
moments.text: King Solomon told the priest Abiathar to go back to his fields in Anathoth. He spared Abiathar's life because he had carried the ark before David and shared David's sufferings.

moments.title: Jeremiah the priest of Anathoth
moments.text: Jeremiah was one of the priests of Anathoth. The LORD called him to be a prophet to the nations, someone who speaks God's words.

moments.title: Danger from Anathoth's people
moments.text: The people of Anathoth were seeking Jeremiah's life. They told him not to speak for the LORD, or they would kill him. The LORD said He would punish them.

moments.title: A field in Anathoth is bought
moments.text: As the LORD had said, Jeremiah's cousin Hanamel came to him in the courtyard of the guard and asked him to buy his field in Anathoth. Jeremiah paid seventeen shekels of silver and signed the deed before witnesses.
